claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Joe Goss on 1876-09-07 near Walton, Kentucky, when the fight was decided in Goss's favor at 11:50 a.m. after a foul.
claims.excerpt: Fight decided in favor of Goss at 11:50 a. in.

claims.statement: The first ring at Rodemacher's farm near Walton, Kentucky, was broken up by the militia after seven rounds, with the fight stopped.
claims.excerpt: stopped at the end of the seventh round

claims.statement: The fight was resumed the same day at a second ring near Walton, Boone County, Kentucky.
claims.excerpt: At 10:15 the ring is being formed amidst much excitement.
places: Pat Lane farm, near Walton, Boone County, Kentucky

claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested on arrival at Newport, Kentucky, on 1876-09-07 and held in the Newport jail.
claims.excerpt: Allen wus arrested and is now in Newport jail.

fights.excerpt: Fight decided in favor of Goss at 11:50 a. in.
fights.notes: Post-Dispatch says Allen was swindled out of the fight by the referee. First ring broken up by militia after seven rounds; decided in Goss's favor on a foul in the 21st round.
